messages.5資源という軽さで高い最低威力のマッチを確実に取り、束縛と沈潜を付ける貫通暴食の: A Gluttony Pierce E.G.O that, for a light 5 resources, reliably takes Clashes with a high minimum power and inflicts Bind and Sinking (assumes Threadspin Ⅲ or higher).
messages.高い最低威力: 威力19~26(解析Ⅲは26~33)で、軽い資源のわりに最低値が: **High minimum power**: Power 19–26 (26–33 at Threadspin Ⅲ), with a high minimum for such light resources. Reliable in Clashes against strong enemies and when SP is low.
messages.束縛: Ⅰコインが的中時に次のターンへ束縛2を付与する(解析Ⅳは3)。次のターン: **Bind**: Coin Ⅰ inflicts 2 Bind next turn on hit (3 at Threadspin Ⅳ). It creates a Speed difference next turn, making Clashes easier to set up.
messages.呼吸とクリティカル: 攻撃前に呼吸回数を得て(4、解析Ⅲは6、Ⅳは7)、クリティ: **Poise and Critical Hits**: Before attacking, she gains Poise Count (4, 6 at Threadspin Ⅲ, 7 at Ⅳ), and on Critical Hit it triggers Tremor Burst and increases Sinking Count (2 at Ⅲ, 3 at Ⅳ).
messages.沈潜の付与: 解析Ⅲから的中時に沈潜4を付与する(解析Ⅳは6)。: **Inflicting Sinking**: From Threadspin Ⅲ, inflicts 4 Sinking on hit (6 at Threadspin Ⅳ).
messages.パッシブ「狩りの呼吸」: マッチ終了時に呼吸2を得る。混乱すると保護2、混乱から: **Passive — Breath of the Hunt**: Gains 2 Poise at the end of a Clash. Gains 2 Protection when staggered and 5 Poise on recovering from Stagger.
messages.強い敵との集中戦闘で、確実にマッチに勝って束縛を入れる使い方が基本。: The basic use is reliably winning Clashes and applying Bind in Focused Encounters against strong enemies.
messages.呼吸を扱う人格と組むと、クリティカルの効果を活かしやすい。: Pairing it with Poise Identities makes it easy to use the Critical Hit effects.
messages.必要資源は怠惰2・暴食2・憂鬱1、精神消耗は覚醒20。侵蝕スキルは威力が下がり、: It requires 2 Sloth, 2 Gluttony, and 1 Gloom, with an Awakening Sanity cost of 20. The Corrosion skill has lower power and adds Rupture from Threadspin Ⅲ.
messages.Ⅲ: 威力が7上がり、沈潜と呼吸が強化される。最低でもここまでは解析したい。: **Ⅲ**: Power rises by 7, and Sinking and Poise are strengthened. Take it at least this far.
messages.Ⅳ: 攻撃加重値が2になり広域化し、束縛・沈潜・呼吸が増える。複数の敵への束縛や: **Ⅳ**: Attack Weight becomes 2 for multi-target attacks, and Bind, Sinking, and Poise increase. It pays off with Bind on multiple enemies and in Sinking teams.
messages.南部センク協会4課: 呼吸を扱う人格で、S3はクリティカルダメージ増加を持ち、ク: **[Cinq Assoc. South Section 4](persona:1106)**: A Poise Identity whose S3 has a Critical damage increase, meshing with the Critical Hit effects.
messages.G社部長: S1・守備が怠惰、S2が暴食、S3が憂鬱で必要資源をすべて出せ、S3: **[G Corp. Head Manager](persona:1103)**: Her S1 and Defense skill are Sloth, S2 is Gluttony, and S3 is Gloom, supplying all required affinities, and S3 inflicts Sinking.
